description: This file contains functions and scripts for platform-specific upgrades and initializations for various hardware devices. It includes preparation steps, upgrade procedures, and environment configuration tailored to specific device models and their firmware upgrade processes.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares initramfs for Xiaomi devices, including wiping UBI partitions if running initramfs.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Removes existing linux and jffs2 volumes from ubi.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes a specified OEM UBI volume.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition, from kernel args or U-Boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade for TP-Link devices, toggling boot environment variables.

methods.name: linksys_mx_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade setup for Linksys devices, managing environment variables and partitions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function always returning 0, placeholder for image validation.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Calls device-specific functions before upgrade based on board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
